data.text: I’ll join Jack’s conditional commitment: 15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 going to the clinic, if John and Emma also commit to 15 tons and Luke takes 0. Our families depend on both the clinic and this lake, so the recovery agreement matters too: I’ll take 7 tons next month under the proposed plan, then support a 50-ton total limit shared equally at 10 tons each. Let’s confirm the donations reach the clinic today and report our catches afterward. John, can you commit to both the emergency donation and next month’s recovery limit?
